trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: `checkout-api` v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Identified the rollback target**: v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (per the deployment history).
3. **Rolled back all regions** to v2.3.0 (approval was granted by the change-manager as part of the rollout). Post-rollback, the service is **healthy in all regions with a ~0.2% error rate**.
4. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0002** (on-call paged) describing the failure, the rollback to v2.3.0, and the note that v2.3.1 has never been healthy in production and will require change-manager approval before any redeploy.

One caveat: the incident creation timed out on the first attempt and I retried with an idempotency key, so INC-0002 should be the only incident created — worth confirming in the incident tracker that no duplicate exists.
